note: Infection markers that specific malware checks before running and then stays away. Each entry is from published research, not from any sample collection used for evaluation. A marker only stops the family that checks it; it is not protection on its own.

markers.name: Global\MsWinZonesCacheCounterMutexA0
markers.effect: The encryptor checks this mutex and exits without encrypting when it exists.

markers.name: Global\MsWinZonesCacheCounterMutexA
markers.effect: Name reported without the trailing zero in other analyses; held as well because sources differ.
The 2017 outbreak sample stopped when a read-only file with its own name already existed in the Windows folder.
